content: Luzingu lwa pha
Yibati lusyamisa, baphangi bama, muna khenda zoosu za Nzambi, mu kutambika lutu lwenu hanga kimenga kya moya, kyatoma yi kina katambwasini Nzambi; byabina byakála bisambu bifwanani yi Ndinga.
Lulandukilaku bifu bya tsi yayi
, kaasi yambulenu Nzambi kalusoba bikalulu mu kuluheka ngangu zimosi za pha, mu kuswasisa buna kazodini Nzambi: mana menina ma bukheti, mana bátambwasa yi mana makonda kifu.

Muna khenda zina kápheka Nzambi, nzimbudini kwena kosu mutu hana kati dya benu ni kabanzaku mu kuditombula lawu, kaasi kabanza mu kudizitisa, kosu mutu hana kitesu kya lukwikilu luna kámukabila Nzambi.
Kikuma, bwosu thwenina yi bibuku byalawu muna lutu lwetu, lwalu lwenina lumosi, amana bibuku byosu bya lutu byisiku sala kisalu kimosi,
yi bwabuna phi betu, ata thwenina lawu, thwenina lutu lumosi mwena Kidisitu amana thwenina, betu boosu, bibuku bya lutu kikuma kya babana yi babana.
Kaasi thwenina yi makabu maswaswana muna khenda, bwosu bwenina khenda zina kátuheka Nzambi: wuna wuvwini kabu dya kubikula, kasongiladya nzila mosi yi malongi ma lukwikilu;
wuna wuvwini kabu dya kusadisa, kadihana mu lusadisu; wuna wuvwini kabu dya kulonga, kadihana mu kilongi;
Wuna wisi hana kikesa, kahana kikesa; kwena wuna wisi kaba, kakabaka yi tsambu yosu; wuna wisi twadisa, katwadisa yi khwakasu; wuna wisi fwila bakwawu khenda, kahangabwa yi mbundu yimosi
Lungongu lwakala lwa kyedika. Yukakenuyoku nganzyanzya mbi; dihanakenu mu kusala mamboti.
Mu mana matadidini kitya kya phangi, kalenu babasa mu lutondu lwa ku mbundu benu yi benu, kalenu batheti mu kuzitisaka bakwenu.
Lukalaku babolu, kaasi kalenu yi khwakasu; kalakenu khakalakani mu mana matadidini kitembu, musadilenu Pfumu hanga bahika.
Sangwalenu muna kikuma kivuvu. Siphenu mbundu mu tangwa dya kiwayi. Kwaminenu muna bisambu.
Yambakenu batu ba Nzambi babana bisi sanda lusadisu. Lulembwaku mu kuyambaka batu.
Sakumunenu batu babana bisi lunyokuna; sakumunakenu kaasi lubundilakaku
Sangwalakenu hakimosi yi babana babati sangwala; dilakenu hakimosi yi babana babati dila.
Kalakenu yi mabanza mamosi benu yi benu. Ludivuninikakaku, kaasi sandakenu mambu mana malúnata mu kudikulumuna. Ludibanzilakaku ni benu kwenu lwenina badimuka lawu
Luvutulaku mbi ku mbi. Kaasi syakenu ngolu mu kuhangaka mambu ma bukheti ku thwala ya batu boosu.
Ho bwalendakana, mu mutindu wuna lwalendila salaka benu, zingilakenu mu ngemba yi batu boosu.
Baphangi batondama, luvutulakaku mbela benu yi benu, kaasi yambulenumoku ku khabu za Nzambi, mukuma básonika: «Mbela kwena meni-meni, meni-meni yivútulaya,» kazimbudini Pfumu.
Kaasi «ho mbeni waku kakala yi nzala, muheka kudya; ho kakala yi kihwinya muheka kunwa; mukuma ho wahangaka bwabuna, makala ma mbawu wubati mulumbikila hana mutwa wandi
Diyambwadilaku ni mambu mambi makununga; kaasi nungaka mbi mu mamboti.
